Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone homepage editorial hero artwork for AIViewer, welcoming AI learning publication
Primary request: create an elegant tactile paper sculpture of an open ivory book whose broad layered pages become gentle ascending steps, an amber sun disk behind the steps, and one restrained small sage-green plant near the top. It should express curiosity, learning and steady progress.
Scene/backdrop: seamless warm ivory studio backdrop and surface, subtle creamy falloff.
Style/medium: sophisticated physical paper sculpture photographed with realistic paper fibers and fine page edges, premium editorial still-life, not a cartoon.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:9, centered subject occupying about 75 percent of width, open book visible completely with comfortable margins; three-quarter front view, cohesive simple silhouette; keep important subject within central 85 percent for a slightly narrower 8:5 web crop.
Lighting/mood: soft natural studio side light, gentle contact shadows, warm, calm, inviting, lovely to read alongside.
Color palette: ivory paper, amber sun, restrained sage leaves, warm muted neutrals.
Constraints: one book, a few broad page steps, one sun disk and one small plant only. No text, no logos, no interface, no people, no robots, no circuit patterns, no watermark, no decorative clutter. Image must be standalone artwork, not a website screenshot.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone AIViewer educational article cover, wide 16:9 landscape, ideally 2400 pixels wide or larger.
Article: AI Basics: Models, Assistants, and Agents Explained. A model maps inputs to outputs; an assistant adds a product interface and context; an agent adds tools and repeated goal-directed actions.
Visual thesis: show the same amber model core alone, within an assistant interface, and within a bounded tool-action system.
Scene: refined tactile tabletop editorial still life against a warm ivory seamless studio background. Across the central horizontal band, three clear sculptural groups with generous breathing space. Left: one small amber cube with softly rounded edges on a slim ivory paper plinth. Center: an identical amber cube sitting inside a sculptural thick ivory conversation-bubble frame, open interior, a small tail cut into the frame. Right: another matching ivory conversation frame containing the same amber cube, connected by a restrained thin curved sage cord to two small sage cuboid tool blocks, arranged in a compact oval loop on the tabletop. The right group is clearly bounded and modest, not magical or infinitely capable. The shapes are real crafted physical editorial props, not an app UI or a technical engineering diagram. No arrowheads needed.
Style: sophisticated art-directed studio photography of hand-built paper/plaster objects, slight organic surface texture, crisp object edges, believable contact shadows, restrained quiet elegance. More adult editorial publication than toy illustration. All three groups equally readable at small size.
Composition: wide 16:9, calm eye-level three-quarter view, all meaningful objects within central 80 percent width and central 65 percent height, generous empty ivory margins above and below for safe crops. Nothing cropped at edges.
Lighting: soft window light from upper left, warm pale shadows, pleasing neutral whites, tactile amber surfaces. Palette: warm ivory, AIViewer amber inspired by #D88A00, soft gold inspired by #F0C75E, very restrained muted sage, no violet or neon.
Text: none. No logos, no watermarks, no screens, no faces, no robot, no brain, no decorative sparkles, no checkmarks, no fake results. This is an illustration of distinct system layers, not a claim of guaranteed correctness or a literal computational architecture.

# Verification cover v2

## Concepts

1. Learner comparing a printed source with notes beside a laptop: directly communicates careful source verification with a believable person.
2. Overhead claim ledger, pencil and printed source: task-specific but loses the requested human connection.
3. Learner pausing between two open reference books: warm and approachable, but less precise about documenting claims.

Selected concept 1 for article relevance and a clear human action at thumbnail size.

## Exact built-in imagegen prompt

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: AIViewer editorial article cover, 16:9 landscape, preferably 2400 pixels wide or larger.
Article: How to Verify an AI Answer: A Practical Workflow.
Reader task: Trace an AI-generated assertion to an original source, compare wording, and record uncertainty.
Visual thesis: Verification is careful human comparison of a source and notes, not accepting a fluent answer.
Scene: A modest, beautiful sunlit home study with warm ivory plaster and pale oak desk. One fictional adult learner, a woman in her thirties in a plain cream shirt, sits studying a printed source sheet beside an open notebook and a laptop. She looks down with natural, relaxed concentration. One hand gently anchors the printed page; the other holds a simple pencil poised above her notebook. Laptop at frame edge with its unbranded back toward camera; do not show a readable screen. Short paragraph shapes on paper softly out of focus and too small to read, no invented data or visible claims.
Composition: Authentic candid editorial photography, waist-up three-quarter view, one person only. Face and both working hands, source sheet and notebook form a clear central triangle entirely within central 80 percent; generous space around head and hands for 16:9, 16:10 and 2:1 crops. Natural facial features and skin texture, anatomically convincing hands and contact with paper. Quiet human moment, no camera-facing smile, no fashion pose.
Lighting: Soft warm window light from left, coherent subtle shadows, realistic depth of field, tactile paper and linen, understated amber notebook edge, desaturated natural skin and wood tones, warm-white dominant palette.
Text: None. No titles, signatures, marks, watermarks, badges, logos or readable interfaces.
Factual constraints: A fictional generated learner, not a real researcher, testimonial, company employee or documented event. No verification checkmark or implication that a specific claim has passed.
Avoid: Plastic skin, airbrushing, extra fingers, exaggerated gestures, neon circuitry, robots, floating UI, magnifying glasses, dramatic luxury offices or stock-photo smiles.

# Gemini Workspace cover v2

Audience: Learners exploring cross-app drafting and the need to preserve source meaning and review actions.

Concepts:
1. Tangible message cards arranged toward a project brief with pencil: shows the article's email-to-brief exercise and ongoing review.
2. Five paper formats in a ring: suggests cross-app possibilities but too broad at thumbnail size.
3. Desk with laptop and open documents: familiar, but too generic and risks invented interface details.

Selected 1 for specificity, clarity and warm visual family. Authentic official wordmark will be composited separately; no AIViewer logo is regenerated.

## Exact prompt

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: AIViewer article cover, landscape 16:9 studio editorial still life.
Article: Gemini's New Workspace Actions: Five Workflows Across Gmail, Docs and Sheets.
Visual thesis: Many messages become a structured draft for review while source material remains available.
Scene: Beautiful tangible paper sculpture photographed on a warm ivory seamless studio surface. At lower left and center, four slightly overlapping thick cream paper message cards, each with a small embossed envelope outline and two shallow blank horizontal grooves (no text). Their edges lead toward a single upright-leaning ivory project-brief sheet on the right with three restrained horizontal section shapes and a small amber paper tab. A real graphite pencil rests beside the brief to suggest human review. No arrows, no checkmarks, no dashboard or product interface. Everything physically resting on the surface with convincing contact shadows.
Composition: One clear left-to-right visual story, modestly elevated three-quarter view. Keep all significant objects inside the central 80%, generous margins; group occupies lower two-thirds. Entire upper-left quadrant completely empty ivory for a separately composited official wordmark. Nothing reaches the image edges. Quiet elegant editorial art, approachable learner website.
Palette: Warm ivory and paper cream, restrained amber #D88A00, ink graphite, faint natural sage supporting tint. Lighting: Soft directional window light, delicate shadows, realistic cotton paper grain and folded edges.
Text and logos: NONE. Do not generate company logos, lettering, readable writing, watermarks or badges. Authentic Google Workspace wordmark will be added separately.
Factual constraints: Conceptual editorial illustration only, not product screenshot, no claim of speed, correctness or automatic approval. No people. Avoid floating objects, neon, robots, glass spheres, glossy plastic, excessive clutter.

Asset type: standalone editorial photo for AIViewer learning-by-doing feature, displayed beside copy in a warm learner-friendly homepage.

Lighting/mood: gentle natural morning window light with soft diffuse shadows, warm, peaceful, inviting, quietly engaged in learning.
Color palette: warm ivory, soft cream, pale natural wood, subtle neutral ceramic.
Constraints: notebook pages are blank; no writing, text, logos, screens, people, watermarks or extra objects. Realistic physical proportions and coherent shadows. No fake user interface.
